{{Quote|Sir, we'll be proceeding directly to the north hover platform. Your personal shuttle is already waiting. There will be no stopping along the way to respond to reporters or protestors. In the event of any untoward activity, you will submit to our custody and do as we say. Any questions, sir?|The Senate Guard to Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' served as a member of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] and was the chief of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] security detail.<ref name="CoD" />  In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> the chief escorted Valorum, along with several other Senate Guards, as he and his [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] left the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] for his personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].<ref name="CoD" /> 

As the procession made its way to the shuttle, [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] employed by the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] launched their [[Attack on Supreme Chancellor Valorum|assassination]] attempt against Valorum. Several [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] shot at the procession with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The timely arrival of two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], helped prevent Valorum's [[Death/Legends|death]], with the Chancellor suffering only a blaster wound to his right arm.<ref name="CoD" />
